protocol: Independently review measurement data overlap, common luminosity, shared systematic sources and combination covariance assumptions.

Begin in a fresh session distinct from the producer without the producer_headline. Enumerate dataset, luminosity and systematic overlap for every measurement pair and recompute covariance contributions.

Reject a packet that combines shared inputs as independent, drops a supplied cross-covariance, or uses the same data twice. Check combination linearity assumptions and retain justified zero correlations explicitly.

Give every finding a located record path and pointer, check ID or source locator and an evidence class. Computed supplied-record checks establish contract consistency; they do not authenticate inputs or grant physics certification.
Preserve missing inputs, conflicting sources and unresolved obligations. Request the cheapest discriminating test; never invent an efficiency, covariance, factor or uncertainty.

Any scientific execution must use the existing admitted method decision, approved plan and supervised launch guard. This card creates no direct native or remote launch path. Never accept your own work or widen approval.
